scope: One frozen ci-profile civvis_orders built from this branch (01ad173e89), run on clones of live Deity Online Kristina culture runs' events.jsonl, each cut after the first state frame of the turn whose host policy window was free (civvis_orders --turn reads a turn's last frame, where a deck change already shows made=true). At war with a threatened home city (164254Z t174, 171451Z t172, 161648Z-cont2 t182) both arms send the same deck and the journal says Flower power waits (3/3). Proposed actions only; no host execution or strength claim.
